tests.assertion_assessment: Retains only the original checkpoint-entrypoint failure as historical Red, separately checks corrected observer sensitivity, and requires exact-candidate Green.
tests.counterexample: A later publication assertion must not be attributed to the old Red; a muted observer must make the sensitivity control fail.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Historical behavior continuity is bounded to the demonstrated original failure; current Green and sensitivity evidence are still required.

tests.assertion_assessment: Candidate/contract change preserves execution history while requiring fresh exact-candidate approval.
tests.counterexample: A stale review or a passing test cannot satisfy the renewed review milestone.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Accepted regression guard; no historical Red claimed; current Green required.

tests.assertion_assessment: Injects death after verifier success and after FF, then resumes exact candidate and folds only the missing validated transition.
tests.counterexample: No rewind or unrelated descendant may be marked integrated; repeated completion must not duplicate state.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Regression guard; preserve the separate failed final_green record as non-Red; exact candidate run is Green.

tests.assertion_assessment: Checks one explicit reviewed reopen and retention of interrupted attempt, candidate, and prior evidence.
tests.counterexample: No authorization, a second reopen, or replacement/deletion of prior attempt must be refused/preserved.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: One-cycle regression guard, not a defect reproduction; no Red is asserted.

tests.assertion_assessment: Checks actionable source-only clone diagnostics and identical supported milestone recovery after explicit refs/objects transfer.
tests.counterexample: Missing refs cannot fabricate completion; transfer must not alter stable task IDs or recovered milestones.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Accepted regression guard; no historical Red claimed; current Green required.

tests.assertion_assessment: Runs real nested verifier/coordinator under timeout while parent owns lock; checks child isolation, receipt-selected finalization, exact reviewed C/V integration identity, and immutable task-base/candidate/contract/runner bindings.
tests.counterexample: Child lock/import deadlock, candidate verifier substitution, wrong receipt IDs, or any identity mismatch must fail.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Two complete historical behavior Reds retained per case; current exact candidate Green and nested real integration are required.

tests.assertion_assessment: Injects interruption after report, ledger, and checkpoint publication; validates idempotent finalization, report completeness, lock order, worker authority, and current eligibility.
tests.counterexample: Partial/conflicting reports cannot finalize or manufacture Red; worker role cannot publish milestones.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Historical behavior Red retained for mapped failure; later setup/runtime error does not erase it; current Green required.

tests.assertion_assessment: Consumes immutable old verifier output and records only milestones validated by its receipt; unsupported/incomplete schema is rejected.
tests.counterexample: Mutated old runner, malformed/incomplete receipt, or implicit success must produce migration/incomplete failure.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Historical-Red-unavailable exception is exact and decision-bound; it claims no Red and keeps behavior assertions plus Green mandatory.

tests.assertion_assessment: Negative controls reject T21 exception activation from P0, wrong work/task/case/decision digest, and unaccepted P1.
tests.counterexample: Any near-match authority must fail; exact accepted P1 decision may authorize only the declared T21 gap.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Historical behavior Red retained for mapped exception-enforcement failure; current Green required.

tests.assertion_assessment: Checks original report/ledger continuity and per-case Red scope, accepted P1 evidence decision, exact C/V pins, and pre-import rejection of unpinned verifier.
tests.counterexample: Setup/runtime error cannot count as Red; a changed verifier copy must be rejected before import; passing-only cases gain no Red.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Historical Red is retained only for the asserted case-level behavior; T21 exception stays explicit; current exact Green required.

tests.assertion_assessment: Selects a new transition by transition identity while retaining consumed prior receipt; stale mutation leaves state/checkpoint/history byte-identical.
tests.counterexample: Replaying prior consumed receipt as new request or mutating request/postimage must fail before publication with no partial writes.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Historical behavior Reds retained for consumed-receipt selection/atomicity; distinct from T13 guard; current Green required.

tests.assertion_assessment: Derives preflight run identities from retained state, assesses with finalization validator, and snapshots all artifacts to prove no writes.
tests.counterexample: Stale evidence is refused; any state/checkpoint/ledger/report/milestone mutation during preflight fails.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Historical behavior Reds retained for read-only derived preflight; current Green required.
